content: Cefixime is a semisynthetic cephalosporin antibiotic designed for oral administration. Chemically, it is identified as (6R,7R)-7-[2-(2-amino-4-thiazolyl)-2-(carboxymethoxyimino)acetamido]-8-oxo-3-vinyl-5-thia-1-azabicyclo[4.2.0]oct-2-ene-2-carboxylic acid, trihydrate. Its molecular formula includes three molecules of water (3H₂O), and its structural formula is specific to its cephalosporin class. The inactive ingredients in Suprax® (cefixime) 400 mg tablets include dibasic calcium phosphate, hypromellose, lactose monohydrate, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol, pregelatinized starch, titanium dioxide, and triacetin. The inactive ingredients in Suprax® (cefixime) 400 mg capsules consist of colloidal silicon dioxide, crospovidone, low-substituted hydroxypropyl cellulose, magnesium stearate, and mannitol. The capsule shell itself contains ferric oxide black, ferric oxide red, gelatin, potassium hydroxide, propylene glycol, shellac, sodium lauryl sulfate, and titanium dioxide. The inactive ingredients in Suprax® (cefixime) chewable tablets, available in 100 mg, 150 mg, or 200 mg strengths, include aspartame, colloidal silicon dioxide, crospovidone, FD&C Red 40 Aluminum Lake, low-substituted hydroxypropyl cellulose, magnesium stearate, mannitol, fantasy flavor permaseal, and tutti frutti flavor. The inactive ingredients in Suprax® (cefixime) powder for oral suspension include colloidal silicon dioxide, sodium benzoate, strawberry flavor, sucrose, xanthan gum, and sucralose (the latter being present only in the 500 mg/5 mL strength).
